name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
label: Quest
description: The chest of the mage Karnitol has been pried open, and it is completely empty. Long, deep scratches on its sides and top suggest neither man nor giant…

clips.title: The story
paras: The chest of the mage Karnitol has been pried open, and it is completely empty. Long, deep scratches on its sides and top suggest neither man nor giant was responsible, and you return to Kreldig Ungor at Nijel's Point.

You study what forced the chest open. Long, deep scratches run along its sides and top. They point to something that was neither man nor giant, and they do not look like the work of a dagger or sword. The chest is completely empty. With nothing else to be done, you close it and prepare to leave, knowing Kreldig Ungor will be disappointed.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You take a few moments to figure out what pried the chest open, and you notice along the sides and top of the chest, long, deep scratches that reveal that something other than a man or giant took interest in it. The marks don't appear as if they were caused by dagger or sword.
After going through the chest you find it to be completely empty.
Not having another course of action, you close the chest and prepare to leave. Kreldig will be disappointed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome back to Nijel's Point, friend. So, tell me what you found.
What!? Nothing? An empty chest ain't gonna get us paid, I'm afraid.
Tell me more about these marks you saw... These slashes.
